messages.author: dcf76927ceaaed45
messages.subject: Can poppr analyse pooled data
parts:
Good day,

I have pooled RADseq data (30 individuals from one population sequenced as one sample) for a partially clonal species of seagrass and I would like to know if I can use poppr to analyse this.
If not, does anyone have any suggestions as to what software might be useful here?

I'd appreciate any tips/advice

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Can poppr analyse pooled data
parts:
Hi Nikki,

As long as you have SNP data for each individual, it should be possible to analyze these data. If you have your data in a VCF file, you can use either vcfR (http://cran.r-project.org/package=vcfR) or pegas (http://cran.r-project.org/package=pegas) to read in VCF data. 

Best,
Zhian
